description: This file defines the base class for all stream filters in the PDFsharp library, including the Filter abstract class and the FilterParms class, which handles decoding parameters. It provides methods for encoding and decoding byte data and strings, as well as utility functions for whitespace removal.

classes.name: FilterParms
classes.description: A class representing the decoding parameters for a filter, possibly null.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: An abstract base class for all stream filters, providing encoding and decoding methods for byte arrays and strings.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Abstract method that encodes the specified data.

methods.name: Encode (string)
methods.description: Encodes a raw string into a byte array using the filter, converting the string with RawEncoding, then applying the byte array Encode method.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Abstract method that decodes the specified data with optional filter parameters.

methods.name: Decode (byte[], PdfDictionary?)
methods.description: Decodes byte data using decode parameters provided as a PdfDictionary.

methods.name: DecodeToString
methods.description: Decodes byte data to a string, using optional filter parameters.

methods.name: DecodeToString (byte[])
methods.description: Decodes byte data to a string with default null filter parameters.

methods.name: RemoveWhiteSpace
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from the byte array, assuming the bytes are characters, and returns the cleaned array.
